effects: Takes exactly `assets` USDC from the signer by transferFrom into the vault (VaultV2.enter: safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)).
Mints armUSDCs vault shares to `onBehalf`. The amount is previewDeposit(assets), priced from vault storage after accrueInterest, and there is no minimum.
formats.shown: Deposit an exact USDC amount into the vault, with armUSDCs shares going to the `onBehalf` address. The number of shares is not shown.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares received is not shown and has no bound in calldata.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets);` is computed from storage, and there is no minShares parameter. In case 0 the signer received 100000 armUSDCs, while the screen shows only 'Share ticker: armUSDCs'.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show this. Calldata has no share amount.

findings.title: deposit: the 'Share ticker' raw constant field and the 'Deposit asset' label on an amount read awkwardly.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit fields: {label:'Share ticker', format:'raw', value:'$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker'} and {path:'assets', label:'Deposit asset'}. Case 0 renders 'Share ticker: armUSDCs' with no amount.
findings.fix: Rename the fields to 'Amount' and 'Receive shares (armUSDCs)', or fold the ticker into the onBehalf label.

cases.notes: The 100000 USDC out is shown exactly. The armUSDCs in has the right recipient and ticker, but no amount can be shown.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns armUSDCs shares from `onBehalf` (the signer here). The amount is previewWithdraw(assets), rounded up and priced from storage, with no maximum.
Sends exactly `assets` USDC from the vault to `receiver`.
If the signer is not `onBehalf`, the burned shares are deducted from the allowance `onBehalf` gave the signer (exit: allowance[onBehalf][msg.sender] -= shares).
formats.shown: Withdraw an exact USDC amount to `receiver`, taken from the position of `owner`.

findings.title: withdraw: the shares burned from the owner are not shown, and the screen does not say vault shares are spent.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(...)` then `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. In case 2 the signer lost 0.187985960887271699 armUSDCs, which the screen does not mention. The reader thought the position 'drops by about 0.18808 USDC'.
findings.fix: The amount cannot be shown. A constant field such as 'Shares burned from owner: armUSDCs' would name the asset.

cases.notes: The USDC in is shown exactly with the right receiver. The armUSDCs burned is neither named nor given an amount. The reader only inferred a lower position.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns exactly `shares` armUSDCs from `onBehalf` (the signer here), spending the signer's allowance when the signer is not the owner.
Sends USDC to `receiver`. The amount is previewRedeem(shares), priced from storage, with no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem an exact number of armUSDCs shares to `receiver` from `owner`. The asset and amount paid out are not stated.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never names USDC as the asset paid out to the receiver.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets);` where asset is USDC. The descriptor's redeem fields hold only shares, receiver and owner. The mint format uses the constant underlyingTicker, and redeem does not. In case 3 the reader wrote 'likely USDC, not stated on screen'.
findings.fix: Add {label:'Receive asset', format:'raw', value:'$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker'} and say 'for USDC' in the interpolatedIntent.

findings.title: redeem: the USDC amount received is priced from storage and has no minimum in calldata.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares);`. In case 3 the signer received 0.188081 USDC, and no amount appears on the screen.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show this.

cases.notes: The share burn is shown exactly. The USDC in has the right receiver, but the asset is unnamed and there is no amount.

effects: Takes USDC from the signer by transferFrom. The amount is previewMint(shares), rounded up and priced from storage, with no maximum in calldata.
formats.shown: Mint an exact number of armUSDCs shares for `onBehalf`, paid in USDC. The USDC amount is not shown.

findings.title: mint: the USDC amount taken from the signer is not shown and has no cap in calldata.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.mint: `uint256 assets = previewMint(shares); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);` and enter does `safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)`. In case 1 the signer paid 1 USDC, and the screen shows only 'Deposit asset: USDC'.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show the amount. The function has no maxAssets parameter.

findings.title: mint: the intent and the interpolated intent do not say the signer pays USDC.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint: intent 'Mint', interpolatedIntent 'Mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}'. In case 1 the screen read 'Mint 1 armUSDCs for 0x...dEaD', while 1 USDC left the signer.
findings.fix: Use an intent like 'Deposit USDC to mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}'.

cases.notes: The USDC out is named only as an asset, with no amount. The shares went to 0xdead, not the signer, and the screen shows that correctly.

redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver,.worst: redeem: the screen never names USDC as the asset paid out to the receiver.

mint(uint256 shares, address onBehalf).worst: mint: the intent and the interpolated intent do not say the signer pays USDC.

summary.worst: mint: the intent and the interpolated intent do not say the signer pays USDC.
